US revises visa rules, capping foreign student stays at four years

The United States has formalized new visa regulations that will cap the stay for foreign students, exchange visitors, and journalists at four years. This change ends the previous flexible duration of status system. The move has raised concerns about potential financial burdens and uncertainty for international students, particularly those from India, prompting India to state its intention to engage with the US on the matter.
